stories.headline: Zelensky faces pressure from Trump at Munich Conference, calls for more US support against Russia
stories.summary: President Zelensky attended the Munich Security Conference where he urged Trump to intensify pressure on Russia and criticized being asked to make too many concessions. Trump publicly told Zelensky to 'get moving' on peace negotiations, while Zelensky pushed for more military aid including Patriot missiles and Tomahawks.

stories.headline: Ukraine and IMF agree to ease conditions on $8.2 billion loan program
stories.summary: Prime Minister Yuliia Svyrydenko announced that Ukraine and the IMF have agreed to simplify conditions for a new $8.2 billion lending program, including easing sensitive tax increases. The agreement follows discussions where structural benchmarks were revised, and the program will be considered at the next IMF Executive Board meeting.

stories.headline: Ukrainian intelligence operations and security service activities against Russia

stories.headline: Head of Presidential Office Budanov addresses Ukrainian youth and discusses peace negotiations
stories.summary: Kyrylo Budanov held an online meeting with representatives of Ukrainian youth organizations abroad from around 150 organizations across all continents. She also reported allocating UAH 231 million to complete school shelter construction in 11 regions and discussed consequences of Russian strikes on customs and tax revenues.

stories.headline: Ukrainian parliament discusses mobilization policy and military service changes
stories.summary: Ukrainian parliament members, particularly from Servant of the People party, discussed mobilization policy changes. MP Fedyr Venyslavskyi indicated mobilization procedures may change soon and suggested making life more difficult for those avoiding recruitment. The discussions touched on demobilization possibilities and mobilization resources.

stories.headline: National Bank of Ukraine reports increase in international reserves
stories.summary: The National Bank of Ukraine reported that net international reserves increased by 6.4% to $43.3 billion in December compared to the previous month. Official reserve assets increased by 4.6% to $57.292 billion, with annual growth of 30.8% from the previous year.

stories.headline: NATO discussions and European security architecture developments
stories.summary: Multiple reports discuss NATO developments including the concept of 'NATO 3.0' based on partnership rather than dependency, tensions with the US over European security burden-sharing, and NATO's assessment that Ukrainian defense is unlikely to collapse in the near term. Discussions also covered NATO exercises revealing vulnerabilities and potential Arctic missions.
